gaps.topic: Per-supplier split of NVIDIA / AMD / Broadcom / Marvell purchase commitments

gaps.would_need: Supplier-side disclosure (e.g. TSMC, SK hynix, Micron customer prepayment/contract liability notes naming customers) or contract exhibits filed with the SEC.
